definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP() AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR'            AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."ControllingArea","d"."CostCenter","d"."ValidityEndDate","d"."ValidityStartDate","d"."IsBlkdForPrimaryCostsPosting","d"."IsBlockedForPlanPrimaryCosts","d"."CompanyCode","d"."BusinessArea","d"."CostCenterCategory","d"."CostCtrResponsiblePersonName","d"."CostCtrResponsibleUser","d"."CostCenterCurrency","d"."CostingSheet","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."Plant","d"."LogicalSystem","d"."CostCenterCreationDate","d"."CostCenterCreatedByUser","d"."IsBlkdForSecondaryCostsPosting","d"."IsBlockedForRevenuePosting","d"."IsBlockedForCommitmentPosting","d"."IsBlockedForPlanSecondaryCosts","d"."IsBlockedForPlanRevenues","d"."CostCenterAllocationMethod","d"."ConsumptionQtyIsRecorded","d"."Department","d"."SubsequentCostCenter","d"."ConditionUsage","d"."ConditionApplication","d"."CostCenterAccountingOverhead","d"."Country","d"."FormOfAddress","d"."AddressName","d"."AddressAdditionalName","d"."CostCenterAddrName3","d"."CostCenterAddrName4","d"."CityName","d"."District","d"."StreetAddressName","d"."POBox","d"."PostalCode","d"."POBoxPostalCode","d"."Region","d"."Language","d"."TeleboxNumber","d"."PhoneNumber1","d"."PhoneNumber2","d"."FaxNumber","d"."TeletexNumber","d"."TelexNumber","d"."DataCommunicationPhoneNumber","d"."CostCenterPrinterDestination","d"."CostCenterStandardHierArea","d"."CostCollector","d"."CostCenterIsComplete","d"."IsStatisticalCostCenter","d"."ObjectInternalID","d"."CostCenterFunction","d"."CostCenterAlternativeFunction","d"."FunctionalArea","d"."ActyIndepFormulaPlanningTmpl","d"."ActyDepdntFormulaPlanningTmpl","d"."ActyIndependentAllocationTmpl","d"."ActyDependentAllocationTmpl","d"."ActlIndepStatisticalKeyFigures","d"."ActlDepStatisticalKeyFigures","d"."JointVenture","d"."JointVentureRecoveryCode","d"."JointVentureEquityType","d"."JointVentureObjectType","d"."JointVentureClass","d"."JointVentureSubClass","d"."BudgetCarryingCostCenter","d"."AvailabilityControlProfile","d"."AvailabilityControlIsActive","d"."Fund","d"."GrantID","d"."FundIsFixAssigned","d"."GrantIDIsFixAssigned","d"."FunctionalAreaIsFixAssigned","d"."CostCenterCreationTime","d"."CostCenterLastChangedByUser","d"."CostCenterLastChangedOnDate","d"."CostCenterLastChangedAtTime","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date" from "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_COSTCENTER_S4_CURR_Delta" d
CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o
  ON o."BATCH_ID"      = b."BATCH_ID"
 AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
 AND o."OBJECT_NAME"   = 'I_COSTCENTER'
